basic_info.description: Spectacular Multi-Level WOW! Home with 4 Bedrooms, 5 Bathrooms including a fabulous Primary Suite with Private Deck.  Remodeled Gorgeous, Open Kitchen. Media Room and Additional Room for Office/Exercise Space. Large Yard. Sweeping Views South from the Bay to the Ocean. Fantastic Home for Entertaining. Incredible Price Per Sq Ft! Mid point between West Portal and Glen Park and close to the Ocean Ave Commercial Disctrict  allowing access to many Restaurants and Services in these desirable strips. Easy access to 280, 101 West Portal Muni and Glen Park Bart.   Please Note: Floorplan Graphic Artist in 2018 showed 3374 Sq. Ft.  Floorplan Graphic Artist from 2023 shows 3362 Sq. Ft. A must visit the inside of this property, This is the Home of your Dreams!
